supported_checks.label_excerpt: Broad central disc protrusion at the C5-6 and C6-7 levels
supported_checks.source_quote: Findings in the cervical spine magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showed broad central disc protrusion at the C5-6 and C6-7 levels.
supported_checks.explanation: The MRI result is represented accurately.

supported_checks.source_quote: She was prescribed 225 mg of pregabalin
supported_checks.explanation: The stated pregabalin dose is preserved.

findings.source_quote: She was maintained on physical therapy.
findings.explanation: The label records physical therapy after the new symptom, but omits that physical therapy continued during follow-up. This is a source-supported ongoing treatment and may be material.

findings.label_excerpt: Tingling sensation from the right axilla to the fingertips, tenderness to the right trapezius muscle, new symptom of tingling sensation on right arm without pain after two months
findings.source_quote: The patient visited the outpatient clinic every two months, due to numbness of the right arm and a pain score of 3 to 8-points on NRS.
findings.explanation: The symptom details omit the recurrent right-arm numbness and its reported pain-score range during follow-up, which are material symptom-course details.

initial.summary: The label is largely consistent with the source, but it omits ongoing physical therapy and material follow-up symptom severity details.
